as_of_content:
The '''Primal Relics''' are earned from completing the [[Well, That's Just Primal]] Special Missions.

== Description ==
''A mighty artifact from a long forgotten age. Awarded for Mastery of the Optimus Primal Special Mission.''

== Relic Boosts ==
* (Tier 1): +1% Attack and Health in Story Missions.
* Bronze: +2%
* Silver: +3%
* Gold: +4%
